outcome: mRNA expression of omentin-1 in visceral adipose tissue (VAT)
mRNA expression of inflammatory factors (TLR2, TLR4, NF-kB, IKkB, IL-1b, IL-1RA, IL-6, IL-10) in VAT
Maternal clinical characteristics (pre-pregnancy BMI, gestational BMI, HOMA-IR, BMI at delivery)
cohort: The study included 116 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 115 normal pregnant (NP) women, all of whom were studied at the time of cesarean section.
finding: Serum levels and VAT gene expression of omentin-1 are not independently linked to GDM, however, GDM women do exhibit an altered inflammatory status in visceral adipose tissue.
cross-section timing: At the time of cesarean section
